actions.description: The Benefits Management Plan defines credible, verifiable target benefits tied to hypotheses and the spark, named owners, realistic milestone timeframes, falsifiable metrics, and concrete disbenefit mitigations — approve it to authorize benefits realization planning
The Benefits Management Plan fails to establish credible benefits, lacks verifiable metrics, or ignores significant disbenefits — reject it outright
The Benefits Management Plan requires further metric definition, timeframe alignment, or risk mitigation before it can be judged

metadata.decision_context: Given a drafted Benefits Management Plan (Stage 3 Benefit), decide whether to approve benefits realization planning, reject it, or request revision before deciding

complexity_profile.rationale: Separate from approve-business-case: the Business Case and Benefits Management Plan are two distinct gates at Stage 3.
